noncomputable def beforeCount [LT P] (priority : I → P) (S : Finset I)
    (π : Equiv.Perm I) : ℕ

@[simp] theorem beforeCount_empty [LT P] (priority : I → P) (π : Equiv.Perm I) :
    beforeCount priority ∅ π = Nat.card I

theorem beforeCount_le [Finite I] [Preorder P]
    (priority : I → P) (S : Finset I) (π : Equiv.Perm I) :
    beforeCount priority S π ≤ Nat.card I - S.card

private theorem beforeEvent_eq_minimumEvent [LinearOrder P] [DecidableEq I]
    (priority : I → P) (hinj : Function.Injective priority)
    (S : Finset I) (b : I) (hb : b ∉ S) :
    {π : Equiv.Perm I | ∀ a ∈ S, priority (π b) < priority (π a)} =
      minimumEvent priority (insert b S) b

private theorem cast_beforeCount_eq_sum [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Preorder P]
    (priority : I → P) (S : Finset I) (π : Equiv.Perm I) :
    (beforeCount priority S π : ℝ≥0∞) =
      ∑ b ∈ Finset.univ \ S,
        ({ρ : Equiv.Perm I | ∀ a ∈ S, priority (ρ b) < priority (ρ a)}).indicator
          (1 : Equiv.Perm I → ℝ≥0∞) π

theorem lintegral_beforeCount_uniformOn [Finite I] [LinearOrder P]
    [MeasurableSpace (Equiv.Perm I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Equiv.Perm I)]
    (priority : I → P) (hinj : Function.Injective priority) (S : Finset I) :
    (∫⁻ π, (beforeCount priority S π : ℝ≥0∞)
        ∂uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (Equiv.Perm I))) =
      ((Nat.card I - S.card : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) / ((S.card + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞)

theorem integral_beforeCount_uniformOn [Finite I] [LinearOrder P]
    [MeasurableSpace (Equiv.Perm I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Equiv.Perm I)]
    (priority : I → P) (hinj : Function.Injective priority) (S : Finset I) :
    (∫ π, (beforeCount priority S π : ℝ)
        ∂uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (Equiv.Perm I))) =
      ((Nat.card I - S.card : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((S.card + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)

theorem beforeCount_rank_eq {U : ℕ} (rank : I ≃ Fin U)
    (S : Finset I) (hS : S.Nonempty) (π : Equiv.Perm I) :
    beforeCount rank S π =
      ((S.image (fun a => rank (π a))).min'
        (hS.image (fun a => rank (π a)))).val

theorem integral_firstPosition_uniformOn {U : ℕ}
    [MeasurableSpace (Equiv.Perm I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Equiv.Perm I)]
    (rank : I ≃ Fin U) (S : Finset I) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    (∫ π,
        ((((S.image (fun a => rank (π a))).min'
          (hS.image (fun a => rank (π a)))).val + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
        ∂uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (Equiv.Perm I))) =
      ((U + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((S.card + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)

theorem count_le_one (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) :
    beforeCount rank3 selected π ≤ 1

theorem count_mean_ennreal :
    (∫⁻ π, (beforeCount rank3 selected π : ℝ≥0∞) ∂law3) = 1 / 3

theorem count_mean_real :
    (∫ π, (beforeCount rank3 selected π : ℝ) ∂law3) = 1 / 3

theorem first_position_bridge (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) :
    firstPosition3 π = beforeCount rank3 selected π + 1

theorem swapped_first_position :
    ((selected.image (fun a => swappedRank ((Equiv.refl (Fin 3)) a))).min'
      (selected_nonempty.image (fun a => swappedRank ((Equiv.refl (Fin 3)) a)))).val + 1 = 2

theorem count_mean_four :
    (∫ π, (beforeCount rank4 selected4 π : ℝ) ∂law4) = 2 / 3

theorem numeric_count_mean :
    (∫ π, (beforeCount numericPriority selected π : ℝ) ∂law3) = 1 / 3

theorem rawMinimum_eq_count (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) :
    rawMinimum π = 100 + 10 * (beforeCount rank3 selected π : ℤ)

theorem raw_mean_differs_from_position_mean :
    (∫ π, (rawMinimum π : ℝ) ∂law3) ≠ ∫ π, (firstPosition3 π : ℝ) ∂law3

theorem empty_subset_count (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) :
    beforeCount rank3 ∅ π = 3

theorem empty_subset_mean :
    (∫ π, (beforeCount rank3 ∅ π : ℝ) ∂original) = 3

theorem empty_subset_sentinel (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) :
    beforeCount rank3 ∅ π + 1 = 4

theorem empty_indices_normalized :
    uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (Equiv.Perm Empty)) Set.univ = 1

theorem empty_indices_count (π : Equiv.Perm Empty) :
    beforeCount emptyPriority ∅ π = 0

theorem empty_indices_mean :
    (∫ π : Equiv.Perm Empty, (beforeCount emptyPriority ∅ π : ℝ)
      ∂uniformOn Set.univ) = 0

theorem singleton_count_eq (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) :
    beforeCount rank3 singleton π = (π 1).val

theorem singleton_count_mean :
    (∫ π, (beforeCount rank3 singleton π : ℝ) ∂original) = 1

theorem singleton_first_position_mean :
    (∫ π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3), (((π 1).val + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ∂original) = 2

theorem full_subset_count (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) :
    beforeCount rank3 Finset.univ π = 0

theorem tied_count (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)) :
    beforeCount tiedPriority tiedSubset π = 0

theorem tied_count_bound (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)) :
    beforeCount tiedPriority tiedSubset π ≤ 1

theorem tied_count_mean :
    (∫ π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2), (beforeCount tiedPriority tiedSubset π : ℝ)
      ∂uniformOn Set.univ) = 0

theorem tied_formula_value :
    ((Nat.card (Fin 2) - tiedSubset.card : ℕ) : ℝ) /
      ((tiedSubset.card + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 1 / 2

theorem tied_mean_ne_formula :
    (∫ π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2), (beforeCount tiedPriority tiedSubset π : ℝ)
      ∂uniformOn Set.univ) ≠
      ((Nat.card (Fin 2) - tiedSubset.card : ℕ) : ℝ) /
        ((tiedSubset.card + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)

theorem adaptive_count (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) :
    beforeCount rank3 (adaptiveSubset π) π = 0

theorem adaptive_count_mean :
    (∫ π, (beforeCount rank3 (adaptiveSubset π) π : ℝ) ∂original) = 0

theorem adaptive_mean_ne_fixed_singleton :
    (∫ π, (beforeCount rank3 (adaptiveSubset π) π : ℝ) ∂original) ≠
      ∫ π, (beforeCount rank3 singleton π : ℝ) ∂original
private theorem positions_complete (a : Fin 3) : a ∈ positions

theorem global_order_of_first_zero (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (hπ : π ∈ firstZero) :
    globalOrder π = [0, 1, 2] ∨ globalOrder π = [0, 2, 1]

private theorem map_globalOrder (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) :
    (globalOrder π).map π = positions

private theorem count_on_first_zero (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (hπ : π ∈ firstZero) :
    (beforeCount rank3 singleton π : ℝ) = 1 + tail21.indicator 1 π

theorem conditional_count_mean :
    (∫ π, (beforeCount rank3 singleton π : ℝ) ∂afterZero) = 3 / 2

theorem placement_means_differ :
    (∫ π, (beforeCount rank3 singleton π : ℝ) ∂afterZero) ≠
      ∫ π, (beforeCount rank3 singleton π : ℝ) ∂original

theorem singleton_order_original_hasLaw :
    HasLaw singletonOrder
      (uniformOn (orders positions singleton : Set (List (Fin 3)))) original

theorem singleton_order_conditional_hasLaw :
    HasLaw singletonOrder
      (uniformOn (orders positions singleton : Set (List (Fin 3)))) afterZero
